question: Which of the following is NOT one of the Rabi crops?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cucumber**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Cucumber** is not a Rabi crop. It is typically grown as a summer or Kharif crop.
 
• **Rabi crops** are sown in winter and harvested in the spring. Examples include **Mustard, Wheat, and Barley**.
